firstPlayerRule: The person who was most recently on a mountain starts.
clarifications: Starting with that player, turns proceed clockwise.
Each later player receives a Rock tile based on player count and order, then places it on their first turn alongside their Meadow tile.

sources.title: Spring Meadow: English rulebook

internalEvidence: Downloaded and rendered the Stronghold Games English rulebook from a retailer mirror. Printed page 4 identifies the most recent mountain visitor as start player and sets later players’ initial Rock tiles; page 7 confirms clockwise play. The hiking map, signpost and meadow/rock tiles match inventory BGG 253684. A secondary review incorrectly claims a random starter, so the publisher-authored PDF governs this entry. SHA-256: ffb385ca42efb5e56ceef0de891aa7e3919eb3027bbd4bf09b41c48ff63e27fc. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the starting instruction, game identity and edition against the publisher-produced rulebook.
uncertainty: The booklet gives no tie procedure or time limit for the mountain visit.
